articles.title: Ukraine hit by almost 300 drones, Volodymyr Zelenskyy says
articles.summary: Russia executed a second major drone and missile attack on Ukraine in four days, resulting in four fatalities and leaving hundreds of thousands without power. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy condemned the widespread assault, underscoring the severe impact on civilians and critical infrastructure, further escalating the ongoing international conflict.

articles.title: Part 5 Raven Rock. Hidey holes for government and military officials to carry on democracy after nuclear war destroys the planet
articles.summary: This article reviews G.M. Graff's "Raven Rock," a book exposing the U.S. government's secret plan for continuity during catastrophic events. It details the extensive network of doomsday shelters and strategic protocols designed to ensure government survival, even if it means sacrificing the wider population. This provides critical insight into national security and emergency preparedness strategies.

articles.title: Budget 2026: FICCI pushes for strenghtening 'Atmanirbharta' in defence, critical minerals
articles.summary: Industry body FICCI has submitted key recommendations for the upcoming Union Budget, strongly advocating for strengthening 'Atmanirbharta' (self-reliance) in India's defence industry and electronics manufacturing. This strategic push aims to reduce import dependency, enhance national security, and boost indigenous production capabilities, aligning with India's broader vision for economic growth and self-sufficiency across critical sectors. Aspirants should note this focus on domestic defence production.

articles.title: New variant of Type 054A frigate in service with PLA Navy, features larger gun, extended flight deck: official media
articles.summary: China's People's Liberation Army (PLA) Navy has commissioned a new variant of the Type 054A guided missile frigate. This enhancement strengthens China's naval capabilities and power projection in the Asia-Pacific. For SSB aspirants, it highlights ongoing global military modernization and the strategic implications for regional security, emphasizing the continuous need for robust national defence awareness.
